'''Skywalker Ranch''' was a destination on Coruscant's subtram in the Coruscant underworld.

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map, referencing the real-world [[Skywalker Ranch]], which was the main production studio for [[Lucasfilm]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> The stop in question is the middle bottom stop on the map, marked in green, where "Skywalker Ranch" is written out in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].
